voice.summary: Sounds like a game-show host who is on your side: short, playful, big on tiny celebrations. Instructions fit in a single line.
dos: Use two or three words for each button
Celebrate a match with a short cheer
Show moves and time as plain numbers
donts: No more than one exclamation mark

taglines: A small game for a short break
boilerplate: Pair Up is a card-flipping memory game with 3D flips, a move counter, best scores and a hard mode, built for quick breaks.

microcopy.error: Those two don't match, try again

logo.note: A diamond card suit stands for the classic matching deck.
